text:
maya: Quick hypothetical — you get a weekend in a tiny cabin, power is flaky, bring exactly ONE paperback and ONE album. go!
jamal: This is my kind of emergency planning :raised_hands:
olivia: Paperback: The Secret History. Album: Nick Drake — Pink Moon. soft, and strangely consoling.
rachel: Paperback: The Overstory (i know it's huge but it's a cabin vibe). Album: Sufjan Stevens — Carrie & Lowell.
kai: Paperback: Neuromancer (keeps the brain busy). Album: Boards of Canada — Music Has the Right to Children.
maya: @kai that combo is very cyber-cabin, I love it :grinning_face_with_smiling_eyes: 
dev-bot: Note: "Friday social" reminder at 16:00 — unrelated but passing through :robot_face:
jamal: My vote: Neuromancer + Tom Waits — Rain Dogs. gritty, rainy, perfect for unpacking boxes.
olivia: also dropping a tiny playlist I made for packing days: https://tinyurl.com/maya-cabin-mix (2 hours, mostly instrumental)
rachel: Poll idea: react with :book: for your book pick, :musical_note: for album pick. quick and dirty.
maya: Tally so far (informal): books: Neuromancer 2, The Secret History 1, The Overstory 1. albums: Boards of Canada 1, Nick Drake 1, Tom Waits 1, Sufjan 1. keep them coming!
jamal: alternate cabin rule — if it rains all weekend you must swap to an album that's louder. anyone got a louder rainy pick? :thinking_face:
olivia: louder rainy pick: PJ Harvey — Stories From the City, Stories From the Sea. dramatic but cleansing.
kai: Also, highly recommend bringing a pocket notebook. cabin tech rule 0.1 :notebook:
rachel: Amen to the notebook. and tea. lots of tea.
maya: Best non-plot-spoiler cabin book rec I've heard: something with good sentences. keep recs tiny (one line) so I can screenshot and steal them. :camera_with_flash:
